title: 直壁低位转向
description: 孔版印刷中，路线由上行转为横向，成人保持双脚低位支撑。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: An original risograph illustration shows a fictional fully clothed adult turning from a short upward sequence into a low horizontal traverse on a vertical wall. Large violet handholds bend the route sideways, while positive turquoise footholds remain close to the thick uninterrupted crash mat. The climber shifts one hand toward the lateral hold with relaxed shoulders and both shoes still engaged. Compose a wide three-quarter scene with generous wall space ahead, the whole figure, and a clear landing zone. Use layered blue, magenta, and pale apricot inks with visible grain. Maintain plausible adult anatomy and contact. No text, brands, jumping, high exposure, or blocked mat.
